story_and_acs:
Track annual limits per policy year. As a claims assessor, I want the number of paid visits or items in each category counted per policy year, so that claims beyond the annual limit are recommended for decline.
AC1: The first policy year starts on the date cover began; each later policy year starts on the anniversary of that date. Each runs for 12 months.
AC2: Annual limits: GP visit 8 visits, consultant visit 4 visits, physiotherapy 10 sessions, prescription 12 items, day case procedure 2 procedures. Inpatient stays have no fixed annual count; they are assessed individually.
AC3: When the number already paid in a category this policy year equals the annual limit, a further claim in that category is routed to decline_recommended with reason code ANNUAL_LIMIT_REACHED.
AC4: When the number already paid is below the annual limit, the annual limit does not stop the claim.

story_and_acs:
Apply the waiting period and its exemptions. As a claims assessor, I want the 182-day waiting period applied, with its GP and accidental injury exemptions, so that new members are not paid for treatment the plan does not yet cover, and exempt treatment is not wrongly declined.
AC1: The day number is the treatment date minus the policy start date, so the start date is day 0. Treatment before day 182 is in the waiting period. Treatment on day 182 or later is not.
AC2: Treatment in the waiting period that is not a GP visit and is clearly not for an accidental injury is routed to decline_recommended with reason code WAITING_PERIOD.
AC3: GP visits are covered from day 0.
AC4: Treatment for an accidental injury is exempt from the waiting period when the provider's treatment description shows the injury was accidental. The exemption removes the waiting period only; the receipt, referral, pre-authorisation and amount limits still apply.
AC5: If a claim in the waiting period may be for an accidental injury but the provider's description does not show it (including when only the claimant's note says so), it is routed to manual_review with reason code UNCLEAR.
